data_provenance: Synthetic demonstration records. These values describe the illustrated scenario.
scenario: Employee asks about an over-limit hotel booking and sees two current source passages.
preview_alt: Policy Desk prototype with a travel-policy question, a suggested answer, and cited handbook passages.

sample_data.question: Can I book a hotel above $180 for a client visit?
sample_data.suggested_answer: Request manager approval before booking. The $180 nightly limit applies before taxes. If comparable rooms are unavailable, attach two quotes and use the exception form.

sources.title: Travel & Expenses
sources.passage: Standard lodging up to USD 180 per night before tax. Requests above the limit need manager approval and at least two comparable quotes.

sources.title: Approval Routing
sources.passage: Route travel exceptions to the employee’s manager through the travel exception form.
